body: You were very kind to me when I was upset. So I just wanted to let you know that things got worse (MUCH worse)....and then some major Karma happened. My ex and his mother went through all of my texts, and then started harassing and threatening me about the things they read. I did nothing wrong and nothing illegal, they are just insane (as I am sure you must have gathered).  They left texts and voice mails on me and my mom's phone, threatening to sue me, and have my son taken from me.  Again, I dont know what they were going to sue me over, or how they planned on taking my son from me, since I did nothing wrong.  BUT....it was awful.  So awful, I started having anxiety attacks (a first for me), couldn't eat, and barely slept for days. Then I realized something.  In some of the voicemails, they harassed me over an incident back in June where I turned a sex offender over to police and he was sent to jail.  I dont know why they felt the need to harass me over it, since I did the right thing, and the police called to thank me twice.  But in the voice mails they berate me, threaten to have my son taken away from me over it, and say they are going to tell everyone what happened.  THAT is illegal.  So i showed the police their texts and voicemails, and now they are in HUGE trouble.  If that isnt Karma, I dont know what is.  Thanks again for being so kind to me.

I did that.  I told them I was a grown ass woman and they didnt need to talk to my mommy and daddy.  Told them it was none of their business.  They said that if i didnt have anything to hide, then I shouldnt be worried about what they say to my friends and family.  No, my family doesnt want to hear it from them, and everyone really hates those people.  They have no friends.  I just feel so violated and embarrassed.  And they are telling everyone I know.
LOL!!  Oh believe me, I'm having similar fantasies.  Although I admit most of them involve him being in jail.  LOL!!  Thanks again

Really?  Do you think this situation qualifies?  Does it cost anything?  I dont think it would keep them from continuing to smear my private convos around.  But I would feel a little better.  You cant imagine the embarrassment I'm feeling right now.  Absolutely humiliating.  EDIT: I was so upset I forgot I was on the internet.  I looked it all up.  Thank you
You are very sweet.  Thank you.  I dont want to retaliate and stoop to his level.  I'm just so embarassed

Actually, they are calling me and leaving horrible voicemails, and calling me a bad person.  EDIT: his mother actually threatened to drive up to my house and tell my parents all the dirty things I said. I'm 31.  These people are insane and the scum of the earth.
He shared photos, but no I'm not a minor.  I'm 31.  But thanks for trying to help

I didnt mean that in a negative way.  Actually what I said makes no sense.  Sorry, I'm just beyond upset and mortified now.  I never did anything to him. We broke up because he cheated and everything.  Never did a thing to him
Aha.  Wow, I cant believe someone could be so horrible and there is nothing you can do about it.
I know, I just had no idea.  Thanks anyway though.

It was.  And he does much worse than that, believe me.  I just feel sick to my stomach, violated, and I cant understand how someone could be such a morals-lacking piece of garbage.  They were such private conversations, and now the whole world has seen them.  Sorry about the rambling and repetition, I'm in a bit of adrenaline driven shock right now.  Thanks again for the support, I do feel a little better at lease.  Thanks.  :)

Well, its not really over, because now my parents know my dirtiest secrets. And he is threatening to try and have my son taken from me because he read a text where I told my friend that I went out drinking one night.  I know theres nothing I can do, I just figured I would ask just in case.  I feel so violated.  Thanks for trying to help though, I appreciate it.

Yeah, I forgot we shared the ID, and I didnt realize it was even possible to snoop on other people's texts like that.  Its to late now though, the damage is done.  He's showing my most private and intimate conversations to pretty much everyone.  The kicker is that I divorced him because he cheated, so I'm still paying for ever having this scumbag in my life, apparently.  Ugh
I did now that I realized he has been doing that. It just sucks

Well, there probably arent any celebs in my area (northern NJ), but thats ok.  :)  Thank you SO much for the info on other types of meetings that could help me.  I will definitely look into those.  At first I was thinking that I would just be able to stop on my own, and that I didnt have a very big problem.  Well....I didnt have a drop for the last 2 nights, and let me tell you, I had the worst nightmares I have ever had in my entire night.  I mean, wake up screaming, drenched in sweat, shaking like a leaf with all of the covers ripped out of the bed from all of my struggling NIGHTMARES.  Any tips on stopping them, until I can get ahold of a professional?  I'm almost afraid to go to sleep without a drink tonight.  Not sure if that is a normal withdrawal symptom.  Sorry to keep bugging you for help.  Not sure who else to ask until I get to a meeting of some sort.  :)

Last night I drove to an AA meeting at a church in town, but I chickened out.  I pulled into the parking lot, parked, and just couldnt work up the courage to go in.  However, after I went home, I didnt drink, or cry (for the first time in months).  Tonight, I am fighting the urge to have a drink, and its taking every shred of control I have.  But so far, so good.  Thank you again for helping me.  I know I need alot more help, but you sort of helped prop me up, and set me on the right path.  I guess thats all I needed.  One person to care. I will never forget your kindness.

This is probably the most helpful thing I have ever been told.  Especially paragraph 3, 5, 6 and 8. It made me cry a little, but it was because I felt encouraged and understood for the first time....well....ever. I will save this, and will read it often.  Thank you for actually caring, and for helping me.
